source.text: 2. 除SetPolicy、CheckPersistPolicy接口外，其余接口调用者需具有ohos.permission.FILE_ACCESS_PERSIST权限，权限定义详见[access_token](https://gitee.com/openharmony/security_access_token)仓

norm.limitation: The README describes other interfaces generally; async delegation and exceptions require independent review.

applicabilityRationale.UnSetPolicy: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:417-436 checks SET_POLICY_PERMISSION_NAME before the manager call.
applicabilityRationale.UnSetPolicyAsync: IDL declares the async method; service.cpp:445-448 delegates directly to UnSetPolicy and inherits its scoped check.
applicabilityRationale.PersistPolicy: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:257-287 checks ACCESS_PERSIST_PERMISSION_NAME before AddPolicy.
applicabilityRationale.UnPersistPolicy: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:289-315 checks ACCESS_PERSIST_PERMISSION_NAME before RemovePolicy.
applicabilityRationale.StartAccessingPolicy: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:482-511 checks ACCESS_PERSIST_PERMISSION_NAME before StartAccessingPolicy.
applicabilityRationale.StopAccessingPolicy: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:513-539 checks ACCESS_PERSIST_PERMISSION_NAME before StopAccessingPolicy.
applicabilityRationale.CheckPolicy: README_zh.md:23 excludes CheckPersistPolicy, not this distinct IDL method; service.cpp:450-480 checks permission before MatchPolicy.
applicabilityRationale.PersistPolicyByTokenId: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:317-350 has a permission check and an AddPolicy call.
applicabilityRationale.UnPersistPolicyByTokenId: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:352-380 has a permission check and a RemovePolicy call.
applicabilityRationale.UnSetAllPolicyByToken: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:590-602 checks SET_POLICY_PERMISSION_NAME before UnSetAllPolicyByToken.
applicabilityRationale.CleanPersistPolicyByPath: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:177-191 instead uses IsFileManagerCalling before the manager call; this is not an unguarded operation.
applicabilityRationale.CleanPolicyByUserId: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:193-207 instead uses IsFileManagerCalling before the manager call; this is not an unguarded operation.
applicabilityRationale.StartAccessingByTokenId: README_zh.md:23 includes this IDL method; service.cpp:576-588 instead requires FOUNDATION_UID before the manager call; this is not unguarded.
applicabilityRationale.SetPolicyByBundleName: README_zh.md:23 includes this distinct IDL method; service.cpp:210-256 has an authorization check, but the current operation-candidate query cannot prove one target.

review.rationale: Builder-LLM interprets README_zh.md:23 for the named IDL methods, excluding SetPolicy, SetPolicyAsync through exact delegation, and CheckPersistPolicy. Applicability alone does not establish a static finding; source-backed proof and explicit limitations remain necessary.
